summary: The library and school community highlight the critical role of E-Rate funding in maintaining reliable internet access and access to digital resources. They emphasize the financial burden of cutting services without E-Rate support and the impact on community access to essential services and programs.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, libraries will have to cut core services, programs, and operations to maintain internet service
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-Rate funding, we will have to cut core services, programs, and operations to maintain the internet service our community requires.
